Report three-process latency distributions and preserve any failed/unsupported cells. Preserve precision, direction, integer width/modulus, matrix coefficients and ordering; include adapter costs. Dao FP32 or GPU-NTT word64 is not a substitute. CPU references may be reported separately but cannot fill GPU speedup cells.

Execute a defined CKKS application with all RNS limbs and actual ciphertext dependencies connected through both backends. Verify application output and report complete-call latency/throughput including conversion, allocation and required transfers. A single-limb NTT adapter probe or operator latency cannot establish CKKS application speedup.

Capture target-supported achieved active-warps/occupancy and L2 hit-rate counters for explicitly selected accepted pairs; attach kernel identities, denominators and aggregation weights. Existing registers/shared and L2 sector bytes do not determine achieved occupancy or hit rate. Keep profiler latency separate from normal timing and record unavailable metrics as missing. The existing profile environment/driver needs explicit GPU2 rebinding before use.

Measure actual public online candidate enumeration, calibration/model ranking, search, compilation, plan setup and first-use wall costs separately from steady-state execution. Record attempted/omitted candidates, budget, cache state, cold versus hit behavior, selected mapping and independent replay. The offline16-candidate pool is ranking/search-protocol evidence, not online setup cost or a completed public first-use measurement.
